id: -2270-薩爾貢大帝在阿卡德帝國東北部的戰役
theater: 敘利亞北部幼發拉底河上游

battle.name: 薩爾貢大帝在阿卡德帝國東北部的戰役
battle.theater: 敘利亞北部幼發拉底河上游
battle.brief: 約前2270年，薩爾貢以三十四場戰役自阿卡德一路上攻，奪取敘利亞北部的馬里、亞爾穆提與埃布拉諸城，毀其城牆，直抵雪松林與銀山，並在阿加德碼頭集結美盧哈、馬甘與迪穆恩的船。卡面的埃及長矛屬早王朝青銅工藝，與本役同屬銅器時代的刺擊兵器譜系，並非本役出土遺物。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場戰爭是阿卡德王國在薩爾貢治下，向敘利亞北部與幼發拉底河上游諸城邦發動的一系列征服戰役，交戰的對手是馬里、亞爾穆提與埃布拉三城。薩爾貢一方是剛剛終結蘇美爾城邦時代的新王權：首都阿加德設有王室官署，國王以「基什之王」的名號發號施令，軍隊由職業步兵、弓手、斧兵與王室的運輸隊組成，並在佔領區設「總督」（sakkanakku）接管行政。馬里是幼發拉底河中游最大的阿摩利特王國，控制河運與鹽路；亞爾穆提在巴力赫河谷，是一個有城垣的小國；埃布拉是敘利亞北部的大城，以其商路位置著稱。三者之間並無聯盟：薩爾貢的銘文把它們列作被奪取的「上國」城邑，逐一歸於阿加德的王權。第三方是海上與山地的貿易圈——美盧哈、馬甘與迪穆恩的船隻在阿加德碼頭靠泊，迦南海岸供應紫螺與雪松，阿馬努斯山一帶出產銀與雪松，這條商路正是本次遠征要打通並控制的東西。需要說明的是：本戰在維基「戰爭列表」所據的英維基百科條目名稱作「阿卡德帝國東北部」，而該條目列出的交戰方卻是位於阿卡德西北方的敘利亞諸城；本篇按交戰方與銘文內容作實，戰場地理以敘利亞北部為準。
countriesEn: This war was a series of campaigns of conquest launched by the kingdom of Akkad under Sargon against the city-states of northern Syria and the upper Euphrates, and the opponents were the three cities of Mari, Yarmuti and Ebla. Sargon's side was the new kingship that had just brought the age of the Sumerian city-states to an end: the capital at Agade housed the royal offices, the king issued his orders in the name of 'King of Kish', the army was made up of professional infantry, archers, axe-men and a royal transport service, and in the occupied districts governors (sakkanakku) were installed to take over the administration. Mari was the largest Amorite kingdom on the middle Euphrates and controlled the river traffic and the salt road; Yarmuti lay in the Balikh valley and was a smaller walled state; Ebla was the great city of northern Syria, famous for its position on the trade routes. The three were not an alliance: Sargon's inscription lists them as the cities of the 'upper land' that were taken, one after another, and brought under the kingship of Agade. The third party was the trading circle of the sea and the mountains — the ships of Meluhha, Magan and Dilmun lay at the quay of Agade, the Canaanite coast supplied the purple shell and the cedar, and the Amanus range produced silver and timber, and that trade route was precisely what the expedition set out to open and control. One point has to be stated plainly: in the English Wikipedia list from which the war of this card takes its name, the entry is called the campaigns in the north-east of the Akkadian Empire, yet the opponents it lists are the Syrian cities lying to the north-west of Akkad. This account therefore follows the opponents and the content of the inscription, and the geography of the battlefield is taken to be northern Syria.
people: 薩爾貢是這場戰爭的策劃者與唯一的敘述者。留存下來描述此役的第一手材料，是他那段著名的銘文：國王自稱在「直到海邊」的地方打了三十四場戰役，毀掉所攻城市的城牆；他令美盧哈、馬甘與迪穆恩的船在阿加德碼頭並排繫泊，自己匍匐在神祇達甘面前祈禱，達甘於是把「上國」，即馬里、亞爾穆提與埃布拉，一直賜到雪松林與銀山為止。這段文字是理解此役的關鍵：它同時是戰果的清單、王權的宣言，也是一份外交文書，說明阿卡德的北方擴張是以神的授權來表述的。薩爾貢的家人也在這套體系裡：其子里穆什以「基什之王」的名義留下了帶名的紫螺殼（盧浮宮 AO 21404，約前2270年），顯示遠征帶回來的戰利品與遠方貨物的流通；其子馬尼什圖什與女兒恩赫杜安娜同樣見於王室傳記，但這一役的具體指揮者沒有留下名字。阿卡德在北方建立的行政網絡可以從泰爾布拉克出土的行政泥板與加蘇爾的莊園檔案看出：後者由名叫祖祖的官員管理，記錄土地、勞役與口糧的分配。對面的馬里、亞爾穆提與埃布拉之王在銘文中一律沒有名字，這是阿卡德王權敘事的通例：對手只有群體名，沒有個人。
peopleEn: Sargon is the man who planned this war and its only narrator. The first-hand material that survives describing it is his own celebrated inscription: the king declares that he triumphed in thirty-four battles over the cities up to the edge of the sea and destroyed their walls, that he made the ships of Meluhha, Magan and Dilmun tie up alongside the quay of Agade, that he prostrated himself before the god Dagan in supplication, and that Dagan gave him the upper land, namely Mari, Yarmuti and Ebla, up to the Cedar Forest and up to the Silver Mountain. That passage is the key to the whole campaign: it is at once a list of results, a declaration of kingship and a diplomatic document, and it shows that Akkad's northern expansion was phrased as an act authorised by a god. Sargon's family belonged to the same apparatus: his son Rimush, who bore the name of 'King of Kish', left a purple murex shell inscribed with his name (Louvre AO 21404, about 2270 BC), which shows how the plunder and the goods of far countries circulated after the expedition; his son Manishtushu and his daughter Enheduanna likewise appear in the dynastic tradition, but no name has come down for the commanders of this particular campaign. The administrative network Akkad built up in the north can be read in the administrative tablet from Tell Brak and in the estate archives of Gasur, the latter managed by an official named Zuzu, who recorded the distribution of land, labour service and rations. The rulers of Mari, Yarmuti and Ebla are given no names in the inscription at all, which is the normal usage of Akkadian royal narrative: the enemy has a collective name and no individual.
kits: 卡面這件埃及長矛屬早王朝工藝：銅或青銅矛頭以銲接或綁紮裝在木杆前端，用途是守城垣與近身刺擊。它與本役相隔約四千六百年，並不出現在近東這條戰線上；阿卡德人手中與之同屬一個技術譜系的，是套接式銅矛，銅矛頭裝在木杆上，長短兩種並行，配合盾牌、銅斧（雙刃斧與象首斧）、短匕首與頭盔，構成這支部隊的近戰骨架。遠程武器是複合弓，攻城則靠銅鎬、木槌、繩索與柴堆；主力仍是步兵方陣——薩爾貢時代沒有戰車，運輸靠牛拉的載具，這正是長矛能充當方陣骨幹的前提。真正獨特的是這一役的舟船：銘文提到美盧哈、馬甘與迪穆恩的船停泊在阿加德碼頭，說明遠征的補給線同時走陸路與海路，海上船隊把迦南海岸的紫螺、雪松與阿馬努斯的銀運回兩河。卡面說明中「守城垣，後來用它收復失地」的敘述，恰好對應薩爾貢銘文裡「毀掉他們的城牆」與「達甘賜予上國」兩句：矛既是攻城之器，也是王權收復失地的憑證。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card belongs to early dynastic craftwork: a copper or bronze head fitted to the front of a wooden shaft by riveting or binding, made for defending walls and for stabbing at close quarters. It stands roughly four thousand six hundred years away from this campaign and did not appear on this front in the Near East; what the Akkadians held that belongs to the same technological family was the socketed copper spear, the copper head set on a wooden shaft, in both long and short forms, working together with shields, copper axes (the double-bladed and the lion-headed axe), short daggers and helmets to form the close-combat skeleton of the army. The ranged weapon was the composite bow, and siege work was done with copper picks, wooden mauls, rope and stacked brushwood; the mass of the army was still infantry in formation — there were no chariots in Sargon's day, and transport was by ox-drawn vehicles, which is precisely what allowed the spear to serve as the backbone of the phalanx. What is peculiar to this campaign is its shipping: the inscription mentions the ships of Meluhha, Magan and Dilmun lying at the quay of Agade, which shows that the line of supply ran by land and by sea at once, the fleet carrying the purple shell, the cedar and the silver of the Amanus back down the rivers. The note on the card that the weapon was used to defend walls and later to recover lost territory corresponds exactly to two clauses of Sargon's inscription, that he 'destroyed their walls' and that Dagan gave him the upper land: the spear is both an instrument of siege and the warrant by which a kingship recovers what it has lost.
tactics: 這一役的戰術可以從銘文的動詞裡讀出來：「打了三十四場戰役」、「毀掉城牆」、「直到海邊」，是一條由南向北、逐城攻取的推進線，而不是一次會戰。馬里扼住幼發拉底河中游，亞爾穆提在巴力赫河谷，埃布拉在更北的商道交會處；薩爾貢的縱隊沿河谷北上，每到一城先以弓手與攻城器材壓制城頭，再用持盾持矛的方陣貼牆作業，以斧兵與撞槌破門，最後由缺口突入。軍隊的推進並非孤軍：河上的舟船隊沿海岸平行北上，使「海邊」成為陸軍可以抵達的極限點，形成海陸兩線夾擊的格局，這在近東的青銅時代戰爭中是罕見的。另一個關鍵是行政與勞役：泰爾布拉克出土的阿卡德行政泥板記錄勞動者名單，說明佔領區的人口被登記編組，負責築城、運輸與供應；守軍的抵抗因此不只是在城頭作戰，而是在後方以一個被榨取的行省來維持。整場遠征的補給靠沿途城邑與宮室的穀物、羊群與船貨支應，這套能力才是薩爾貢能把戰線推出七百公里的真正原因。
tacticsEn: The tactics of this campaign can be read off the verbs of the inscription: 'thirty-four battles', 'destroyed their walls', 'up to the edge of the sea'. It is a line of advance running from south to north, city by city, and not a single pitched battle. Mari commands the middle Euphrates, Yarmuti lies in the Balikh valley, Ebla stands further north where the trade routes cross. Sargon's column moved up the river valleys and, at each city, the archers and the siege equipment first silenced the walls, then the phalanx of spearmen and shield-bearers closed along the rampart to work at it, the axe-men and the mauls broke the gates, and the troops came in through the gap. The advance was not made by a lone army: the fleet on the river ran north in parallel along the coast, so that the 'edge of the sea' became a limit the land army could actually reach, and the two lines, by land and by sea, closed on the enemy — a pattern rare in Bronze Age warfare in the Near East. The second key was administration and labour: the Akkadian administrative tablet from Tell Brak lists labourers by name, which shows that the population of the occupied districts was registered and enrolled to build, to haul and to supply; the resistance of the defenders was therefore not only fought on the walls but sustained behind them by a province that was being drained. The whole expedition was fed by the grain, the flocks and the boat cargo of the towns and the palace along the route, and that capacity is the real reason Sargon could push a front seven hundred kilometres out.
data: 可核對的數字有這些：銘文自記「三十四場戰役」，並說戰線「直到海邊」；該銘文在文獻中常被繫於前2270至前2215年，涵蓋薩爾貢及其後繼者的年代，而中型年表把薩爾貢的統治定在前2334至前2279年，本卡標出的前2270年正落在他在位的末段，隨後即由其子里穆什繼位。英維基百科「前1000年戰爭列表」的相應條目則把此役標為「前23世紀早期」，交戰方列馬里、亞爾穆提、埃布拉。地理上，阿加德的位置未定，一般認為在幼發拉底河中游靠近西帕爾一帶，由此到馬里約三百公里，到亞爾穆提約四百五十公里，到埃布拉約六百至七百公里，銘文提到的雪松林與銀山則在更北的阿馬努斯山一帶。帝國規模方面，阿卡德版圖的估計面積約八十萬平方公里（在納拉姆辛治下的鼎盛期）。考古旁證包括：泰爾布拉克的薩爾貢時期建築與行政泥板（不列顛博物館 BM 131738）、出土於該處的薩爾貢時期石器杯、加蘇爾的莊園泥板，以及約前2270年、出自迦南海岸的紫螺殼（盧浮宮 AO 21404）。至今沒有任何遺跡被認定為此役的戰場，銘文也沒有留下確切日期、交戰地名與雙方死傷數字。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are these: the inscription counts its own 'thirty-four battles' and says that the front reached 'up to the edge of the sea'; that inscription is commonly dated in the literature to 2270–2215 BC, a span that covers Sargon and his successors, while the Middle Chronology puts Sargon's reign at 2334–2279 BC, so the year marked on this card, 2270 BC, falls at the very end of his reign, after which his son Rimush succeeded him. The corresponding entry in the English Wikipedia list of wars before 1000 dates the campaign to the 'early 23rd century BC' and names Mari, Yarmuti and Ebla as the opponents. Geographically, the site of Agade is still undetermined and is generally placed in the middle Euphrates near Sippar; from there it is about three hundred kilometres to Mari, about four hundred and fifty to Yarmuti and about six to seven hundred to Ebla, while the Cedar Forest and the Silver Mountain named in the inscription lie further north in the Amanus range. On the scale of the empire, the Akkadian area is estimated at about eight hundred thousand square kilometres, at its height under Naram-Sin. The archaeological evidence includes the Sargonic structures and the administrative tablet from Tell Brak (British Museum BM 131738), the Sargonic stoneware cups found there, the estate tablets of Gasur, and the purple murex shell of about 2270 BC from the Canaanite coast (Louvre AO 21404). No archaeological site has been identified as the battlefield of this campaign, and the inscription leaves no exact date, no place of fighting and no casualty figures on either side.
cause: 這場戰爭的起因，是阿卡德完成兩河統一之後必然向外延伸的推力。薩爾貢打倒拉伽爾·扎吉西、終結蘇美爾各城邦的獨立之後，新王權需要新的收入、新的資源與新的合法性，而這三樣東西都在北方：幼發拉底河上游與地中海東岸的商路帶來木材、金屬、銀與紫螺，沿海的城邦控制著阿馬努斯的雪松林，而達甘這位「上國」之神所劃定的疆界，正是阿卡德王權要伸手去抓的東西。另一層原因是安全與機會：阿摩利特系的馬里與埃布拉長期獨立，其中埃布拉在商道上與阿卡德遙相角力；兩河流域的城邦聯盟在薩爾貢時代已經瓦解，剩下的是各城各自為政，這種格局對一個剛剛形成的帝國而言既是最靚的獵物，也是最大的不確定性。於是「上國」在薩爾貢的政治語言裡同時是財富、邊界與神恩：遠征的真正動力，是王權要把「四方之王」的稱號從紙面變成地理。
causeEn: The cause of this war is the outward push that necessarily followed Akkad's unification of the two rivers. When Sargon had beaten Lugal-zage-si and ended the independence of the Sumerian city-states, the new kingship needed new revenue, new resources and new legitimacy, and all three lay to the north: the trade routes of the upper Euphrates and the Levantine coast carried timber, metal, silver and the purple shell; the coastal cities held the cedar forests of the Amanus; and the boundary drawn by Dagan, the god of the 'upper land', was exactly the territory the Akkadian kingship wanted to reach for. A second cause is security and opportunity: the Amorite kingdom of Mari and the city of Ebla had long stood independently, and Ebla in particular contested Akkad's influence from its position on the trade routes. The league of Mesopotamian city-states had already broken up in Sargon's time, leaving each city on its own, and such a pattern was for a newly formed empire both the richest quarry and the greatest uncertainty. The 'upper land' was therefore, in the political language of Sargon, at once wealth, frontier and divine gift: the real driving force of the expedition was the wish of a kingship to turn the title 'King of the Four Quarters' from a phrase into a geography.
impact: 此役的直接後果，是阿卡德的邊界從兩河下游推到了敘利亞北部。泰爾布拉克在敘利亞出現薩爾貢時期的建築、行政泥板與石器杯，說明阿卡德在攻下之地設了常設的行政與分配機構，而不是打完就走；里穆什那只約前2270年的紫螺殼則顯示遠征帶回的不只是俘獲，還有迦南海岸的物產與航路。帝國的面積因此膨脹到約八十萬平方公里，其影響力自地中海延伸到伊朗高原，並經海路達到美盧哈、馬甘與迪穆恩。另一方面的收穫是意識形態：「四方之王」的說法在薩爾貢時已成形，到其孫納拉姆辛手上進一步發展，那塊記載他擊敗盧魯比人的勝利石碑把英雄國王的形象推到頂點，王室藝術也在這一時期重塑了戰爭與君王的樣貌。代價與脆弱同樣清楚：如此遠的戰線依賴被榨取的行省維持，一旦中心失勢，整張網就斷——古提人在前2150年前後攻入兩河，阿卡德在敘利亞與北方的存在隨王朝崩潰而消失；這一役開出的通路，只換來幾百年的壽命與一整套被後人神化的記憶。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of this campaign was that Akkad's frontier was pushed from the lower two rivers up into northern Syria. The Sargonic structures, the administrative tablet and the stoneware cups at Tell Brak in Syria show that Akkad set up permanent administrative and distribution offices in the country it had taken, instead of marching on and leaving; and the purple murex shell of Rimush, of about 2270 BC, shows that the expedition brought back not only captives but the produce and the routes of the Canaanite coast. The area of the empire swelled to some eight hundred thousand square kilometres, its influence reaching from the Mediterranean to the Iranian plateau and, by sea, as far as Meluhha, Magan and Dilmun. The other gain was ideological: the formula 'King of the Four Quarters' took shape under Sargon and was carried further by his grandson Naram-Sin, whose Victory Stele, recording his defeat of the Lullubi, carried the image of the heroic king to its height, and the royal art of the age reshaped the appearance of both war and kingship. The cost and the fragility were equally plain: a front that far depended on provinces that were being drained, and once the centre failed the whole net came apart. The Gutians entered the two rivers around 2150 BC, and the Akkadian presence in Syria and in the north disappeared with the collapse of the dynasty. The corridor opened by this campaign bought a few centuries of life and a memory that was afterwards made into legend.
result: 結果就寫在薩爾貢自己的句子裡：三十四場戰役，所到之處「毀掉他們的城牆」，戰線推到海邊，馬里、亞爾穆提與埃布拉連同雪松林與銀山一線歸入「上國」，由神賜給國王；美盧哈、馬甘與迪穆恩的船在阿加德碼頭並排繫泊，作為遠征的戰利品與通路的證明。就軍事結果而言，這是一場壓倒性的勝利：沒有一次敗績被記錄下來，銘文通篇只有進攻與摧毀。就政治結果而言，阿卡德取得了一條自兩河通向地中海的走廊、一批北方的城與人口，以及一批可由王權再分配的資源。就戰役的界限而言，同一段銘文的年代被繫於前2270至前2215年，跨越薩爾貢、里穆什、馬尼什圖什與納拉姆辛數代，因此這一役並非一次孤立的出擊，而是阿卡德北方政策的一個階段；它的成果在王朝覆亡時隨之散盡，但它留下的疆界尺度、王權語言與英雄形象，後來在《埃努瑪埃利什》的創世敘事裡被半神話化地重演，又在兩千多年後被亞述王薩爾貢二世借用為正統的名號。
resultEn: The outcome is written in Sargon's own sentences: thirty-four battles, and wherever he went he 'destroyed their walls'; the front was carried to the edge of the sea; Mari, Yarmuti and Ebla, with the Cedar Forest and the Silver Mountain, passed into the 'upper land' given by a god to the king; and the ships of Meluhha, Magan and Dilmun lay tied up in a row at the quay of Agade, both as the spoil of the expedition and as the proof of the corridor it had opened. In military terms the result was an overwhelming victory: no defeat is recorded anywhere, and the inscription is unbroken advance and destruction. In political terms Akkad gained a corridor from the two rivers to the Mediterranean, a body of northern cities and populations, and a stock of resources that the kingship could redistribute. As for the limits of the campaign, the same inscription is dated to 2270–2215 BC, a span that crosses the reigns of Sargon, Rimush, Manishtushu and Naram-Sin, so this was not an isolated sortie but a stage of the northern policy of Akkad. Its achievements were scattered when the dynasty fell, but the scale of its frontier, the language of its kingship and the image of its hero were later half-mythologised in the creation narrative of the Enuma Elish, and two thousand years afterwards borrowed by the Assyrian king Sargon II as a name of legitimate descent.
